mapper.select: select count(case when bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime} then 1 end) as paid_order_count, coalesce(sum(case when bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime} then bo.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as gross_revenue, coalesce(sum(case when bo.refund_at >= #{startTime} and bo.refund_at < #{endTime} then bo.total_amount else 0 end), 0) as refund_amount, coalesce(sum(case when bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime} then bo.quantity else 0 end), 0) as sold_ticket_count, (select count(*) from ticket t join booking_order_item item on item.id = t.order_item_id join booking_order ticket_order on ticket_order.id = item.order_id join admission_session ticket_session on ticket_session.id = ticket_order.session_id where ticket_session.venue_id = #{venueId} and t.verified_at >= #{startTime} and t.verified_at < #{endTime}) as verified_ticket_count from booking_order bo join admission_session s on s.id = bo.session_id where s.venue_id = #{venueId} and ((bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime}) or (bo.refund_at >= #{startTime} and bo.refund_at < #{endTime}))

select cast(bo.paid_at as date) as statistic_date, count(*) as paid_order_count, coalesce(sum(bo.total_amount), 0) as gross_revenue, coalesce(sum(bo.quantity), 0) as sold_ticket_count from booking_order bo join admission_session s on s.id = bo.session_id where s.venue_id = #{venueId} and bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime} group by cast(bo.paid_at as date) order by statistic_date

select item.ticket_type_name, count(*) as sold_quantity, coalesce(sum(item.unit_price), 0) as sales_amount from booking_order_item item join booking_order bo on bo.id = item.order_id join admission_session s on s.id = bo.session_id where s.venue_id = #{venueId} and bo.paid_at >= #{startTime} and bo.paid_at < #{endTime} group by item.ticket_type_name order by sold_quantity desc, item.ticket_type_name
